chunks: Zur'ah narrated from Sama'ah, who said:

I asked him about two men who jointly owned a bondwoman and married her to a man. Then that man purchased part of the two shares. He said: "She becomes prohibited to him by his purchasing her, and that is because her sale is her divorce, unless he purchases her completely."

key_terms.فَزَوَّجَاهَا: the two owners married her off

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a husband buys a share of a jointly owned bondwoman who was married to him?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a bondwoman jointly owned by two men who had married her to another man. If the husband then purchases only part of her ownership share, she becomes prohibited to him, because the sale of a bondwoman is treated as effecting separation from the previous marital arrangement unless he acquires her in full.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4554 - Zur'ah narrated from Sama'ah, who said:

I asked him about two men who jointly owned a bondwoman and married her to another man. Then, one of the two owners purchased the other's share.
Imam (as) said: "She becomes prohibited for him by his purchase of her, because buying her is equivalent to divorcing her, unless he purchases her completely."
